name: Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker
summary: At Stormwind's Cathedral of Light, Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker trains champions of the Light. A veteran paladin commander of the Knights of the Silver Hand, he guides promising knights and oversees the sacred trials senior paladins must complete to claim their holy chargers.

sections.title: Master of the Silver Hand
sections.body: Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker leads the Silver Hand's work in Stormwind City and ranks among the Alliance's foremost defenders. A veteran of the order, he trains recruits in arms and tests their faith in the Light. When promising knights are ready, he sends them north to the contested front lines of the Western Plaguelands. There, they aid Commander Ashlam Valorfist at Chillwind Camp.

sections.title: The Trials of the Holy Charger
sections.body: For paladins seeking a sacred warhorse, Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker requires sacrifice and virtue. The trials include acts of charity, such as helping Ironforge's impoverished through High Priest Rohan, perilous journeys to exorcise Terrordale, and the cleansing of ancient spirits within Dire Maul. At Scholomance, an initiate must face the death knight Darkreaver and use the Light to free an unholy steed from servitude.

faq.q: Where can I find Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker?
faq.answer: Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker is inside the Cathedral of Light in Cathedral Square, Stormwind City. He stands in the main halls, overseeing the paladins of the Silver Hand.

faq.q: What is Lord Grayson's role for paladins?
faq.answer: Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker trains Alliance paladins. He sends young knights to the front lines against the Scourge in Lordaeron and guides the sacred trials to make holy barding and claim a paladin charger.

faq.q: Did Lord Grayson lose an eye?
aliases: how did grayson lose his eye
why is grayson missing an eye
faq.answer: No account from these days tells whether Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker lost an eye, or how. He is known as a veteran lord of the Silver Hand and one of the Alliance's foremost paladins.

faq.q: What is his connection to the Forsaken?
faq.answer: No known account ties Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker or his family to the Forsaken. He is a paladin of the Silver Hand who sends knights to fight the Scourge in Lordaeron.

faq.q: Why does Grayson send paladins to Grimand Elmore?
faq.answer: Grimand Elmore forged the barding for Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker's own charger years ago. Grayson sends worthy initiates to Grimand to craft their Arcanite Barding, which must balance physical endurance with spiritual harmony.

angles.text: As a paladin, you can look to Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker as a senior spiritual mentor in the Alliance. He guides you in the fight against the Scourge in Lordaeron and leads the trials to summon a true charger.
As an Alliance member, you can count on Lord Grayson Shadowbreaker, a veteran of the Silver Hand, to strengthen Stormwind's defense and aid expeditions to the contested northern kingdoms.
